triggers: what is the difference between a resume and a cv
should i use a cv or a resume
template: The main difference between {context} and a CV (Curriculum Vitae) is length and purpose. While a resume is typically a concise 1-2 page document tailored for a specific job, a CV is a comprehensive record of your entire academic and professional history. CVs are more common in academia, medicine, or when applying for roles in Europe and Asia.
fallback: Resumes are short, tailored professional summaries, while CVs are detailed, comprehensive academic and professional histories.

template: The reverse-chronological format for {context} is the most traditional layout. It lists your work experience starting with your current or most recent position and works backward.
